title: We're Building AI to Replace Ourselves. What's the Plan?
why_read: A casual opinion piece speculating about AI replacing developer jobs, offering personal musing rather than concrete technical analysis.
analysis: This is a conversational blog post reflecting on how AI coding agents are increasingly embedded in day-to-day development work, wondering aloud what happens to jobs if AI eventually can do everything. It doesn't present any data, research, or technical methodology, relying instead on anecdote and speculation about future job markets. It may resonate with readers who share similar anxieties, but it offers little substantive technical content for an engineering digest.
